build_guide_transformer_model: build a GuideTransformer model with configurable tokens, heads, layers, and rotary embeddings for audio conditioned generation
encode_audio_features: encode raw stereo audio into feature embeddings using the GuideTransformer encode_audio method
generate_tokens_autoregressively: generate token sequences autoregressively from audio conditions using nucleus sampling with configurable top_p
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the GuideTransformer with tokens and audio condition tensors
review_guide_transformer_generate: review the GuideTransformer generate method for autoregressive token generation with top_p nucleus sampling
